we introduce ConvergeFlow, an embedding-space flow-based LM, which constrains the data predictor to the convex hull of token embeddings and trains it solely with the mean squared error objective induced by flow matching.
we prove that the resulting flow converges to valid token embeddings despite errors in the data predictor, enabling direct token prediction without a CE-supervised decoder.
Our code is available at https://github.com/Na-Li66/ConvergeFlow.
ConvergeFlow is the first flow-based LM with provable convergence to token embeddings.
ConvergeFlow achieves a Gen. PPL of33.17while maintaining an entropy of5.44; see Figure 1 and Table 1 for details.

At the dataset entropy of5.44, our method achieves a Gen. PPL of33.17, whereas the lowest Gen. PPL among the continuous flow-based LMs is approximately60, even though these models are evaluated at entropies below the dataset entropy.
